ある質問が、次の候補のうちどれについて尋ねているかを判定してください。

質問: カスタマイズ済みの内部リンクを短縮してコピーするには、メインメニューのダッシュボードから対象を選択し、共有ボタンを押すという手順で操作できますか？

候補:
A. Share a snapshot: A dashboard snapshot publicly shares a dashboard while removing sensitive data such as queries and panel links, leaving only visible metrics and series names. Anyone with the link can access the snapshot.

You can publish snapshots to your local instance or to [snapshots.raintank.i
B. Delete a snapshot: To delete existing snapshots, follow these steps:

1. Navigate to **Dashboards > Snapshots** in the main menu.
1. To confirm which snapshot you're about to delete, click **View** on the snapshot row.

   The URLs for panel and dashboard snapshots from the same dashboard look simil
C. Share an external link: Externally shared dashboards allow you to share your Grafana dashboard with anyone. This is useful when you want to make your dashboard available to the world without requiring access to your Grafana organization.

Learn how to configure and manage externally shared dashboard
D. Schedule a report: {{< admonition type="note" >}}
This feature is only available on Grafana Enterprise.
{{< /admonition >}}

To share your dashboard as a report, follow these steps:

1. Click **Dashboards** in the main menu.
1. Click the dashboard you want to share.
1. Click the **Share** drop-down 
E. Share dashboards and panels: Grafana enables you to share dashboards and panels with other users within your organization and in certain situations, publicly on the web. You can share using:

- Direct links with users in and outside of your organization
- Snapshots
- Embeds
- PDFs
- PNG image files

F. Quick-share an internal link: Once you've customized an internal link, you can share it quickly by following these steps:

1. Click **Dashboards** in the main menu.
1. Click the dashboard you want to share.
1. Click the **Share** button, not the drop-down list icon, to copy a shortened link.

This l
G. Share an internal link: To share a customized, direct link to your dashboard within your organization, follow these steps:

1. Click **Dashboards** in the main menu.
1. Click the dashboard you want to share.
1. Click the **Share** drop-down list in the top-right corner and select **Share internally*
H. Share dashboards {#share-a-dashboard}: You can share dashboards in the following ways:

- [Internally with a link](#share-an-internal-link)
- [Externally with anyone or specific people](#share-an-external-link)
- [As a report](#schedule-a-report)
- [As a snapshot](#share-a-snapshot)
- [As a PDF expo

- 質問の内容に最も合う候補の記号を choice に書く。
- 二つ以上の候補が同じくらい当てはまり、質問だけではどれか決められないときは ambiguous を true にする。
- reason に判断の理由を短く書く。
JSON で答えてください。

content: {"choice": "F", "ambiguous": false, "reason": "質問にある「カスタマイズ済みの内部リンクを短縮してコピーする」という操作手順が、候補Fの「Quick-share an internal link」の内容（メインメニューのDashboardsから対象を選択し、Shareボタンで短縮リンクをコピーする）と完全に一致するため。"}
